name: Camp West (Garden City, UT) Grilled Chicken Breast on Soft Potato Bun
brandOrRestaurant: Camp West Burgers & Shakes (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Pure grilled chicken breast on an ultra-soft potato flour bun with light mayo. Potato buns are exceptionally tender, and unbreaded chicken is easy on digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Chicken Sandwich plain or with mayo only (hold lettuce, tomato, and onion).
